facts.fact: TechTrends KE describes the Data Protection Act, 2019 as the framework under which the ODPC regulates the processing of personal information, without giving a commencement date; dated by the article's published date.

TechTrends KE reports the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner was established under the Data Protection Act, 2019, with inaugural commissioner Immaculate Kassait in office since 2020 and a Senior Deputy Data Commissioner serving; the Public Service Commission shortlisted 13 of 152 applicants to succeed her.
